## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta9

### Use integration-owned current-cycle mowing area
- Render the default **Current cycle** mowing footprint directly from Navimower 0.4.3-beta56+ `current_cycle_render` instead of stacking all completed session archives from today.
- Keep cycle/reset/continuation decisions entirely in the integration; the card only draws the ready-made backend SVG path.
- Preserve the live active trail as a separate overlay while mowing.
- Preserve historical date views and session highlighting with the existing completed-session archive renderer.
- Avoid browser-side cycle reconstruction and additional completed-session fetches in the default view.

This fixes cases where a zone could show nearly 100% mowed area on the default map even though the current mowing cycle was only partially complete after multiple same-day cycles.
